people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul said, “Draw near here, all you chiefs of the people; and know and see in which this sin has been today.
translations.bsb: Therefore Saul said, “Come here, all you leaders of the troops, and let us investigate how this sin has occurred today.
translations.kjv: And Saul said, Draw ye near hither, all the chief of the people: and know and see wherein this sin hath been this day.
translations.asv: And Saul said, Draw nigh hither, all ye chiefs of the people; and know and see wherein this sin hath been this day.
